counter.label: Counter
counter.does: builds while you stay on one camera
counter.answer: switch camera, or lower the monitor

watched.label: Watched
watched.does: moves only when no camera is on her
watched.answer: keep a camera on her, or shut the door when she is at it

monitor.label: Monitor-gated
monitor.does: waits in the office and steps closer as you raise or lower the monitor
monitor.answer: stop touching the monitor, or shut her side's door

path.label: Path walker
path.does: walks a route through the building one room at a time
path.answer: shut the door she is at, or hold a camera on her at the hall to turn her back

vent.label: Vent crawler
vent.does: crawls the vent run (CAM 9) to one of the three office vents
vent.answer: seal that vent before she arrives, or flash the vent light when she is at its branch

winder.label: Winder
winder.does: hums with a music box on one camera; when it runs down she walks to a door
winder.answer: view the box's camera and hold wind, or shut the door she is at
